title: Padded machine coding
statement: A padded machine coding consists of an encoding of every binary-choice Turing machine with finitely many work tapes and states as a finite binary string, a decoding map from every finite binary string to such a machine, and the property that appending any finite number of $1$ bits to a machine's code still decodes to that machine.
hypotheses_covered: Encoding from machines to finite binary strings
Decoding from every finite binary string to a machine
Decoding remains unchanged after any number of trailing $1$ bits
